column4: Repair mesh-health-warning-task replay pacing: after a recovered historical cursor, it must not create or dispatch an unbounded burst of health-owned triages while Health has work. Bound new warning admission to at most one RUNNING health-warning triage plus one sent/open queued health-warning triage; when full, retain the current source event for a later retry rather than create another chain or advance past it. Preserve durable partial-create dispatch retry, terminal blocked/complete recognition, and no-loss cursor semantics. Add red regression proving a replay with many warnings emits no more than the bound and later admits the held exact event after capacity frees; verify source/deployed parity and a temporary safe fixture. Record existing pre-fix backlog honestly; do not delete or falsely terminalize it. Artifact docs/task-receipts/health-warning-backpressure-20260909.md.
